full_text:
Fenris blessing

Effects: Fists +15 | Damage Modifier: Resistant (0.5x) VS Fire

Introduction. Fenris blessing is a status effects which provides the player with Fire resistance and increases the Fists skill by 15, but does not exceed the skill cap of 100.

Requirements. The effect is granted by wearing all three pieces of the Fenris armor set.
